snippet.title: Game Boy Color - Puzzle de Shoubuyo! Wootama-chan © 2000 Naxat Soft - Gameplay
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
Puzzle de Shoubuyo! Wootama-chan is a Puzzle game, developed by Kouyousha and published by Naxat Soft, which was released in Japan in 2000.
